description: This file defines the LoginScreen widget for a Flutter application, managing user login with email and password inputs, validation, submission handling, UI states like loading and error messages, and navigation triggers after login. It uses provider for state management and theme for styling.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the login screen with email and password fields, validation, submit logic, and UI states.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the login form, input controllers, validation, submission, and UI updates.

methods.name: _validateEmail
methods.description: Validates the email input for presence and format.

methods.name: _validatePassword
methods.description: Validates the password input for presence and minimum length.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form submission: validates inputs, calls login method from provider, updates UI state, and manages async behavior.
